differences.openwhisper: When meetings follow the dictation engine and dictation runs on the paired computer, resolve_meeting_speech answers source remote, so meeting audio goes to that computer too.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: The same settings resolve to this computer's Parakeet model (source local); a meeting uses the paired computer only when the meeting has its own remote source and that host is confirmed for the meeting.
differences.reason: A dictation preference does not authorize sending meeting audio to another computer; it is the settings half of difference a25-remote-meeting-consent.
differences.source: src/models/meeting_speech.cpp and tests/models/test_meeting_speech.cpp ('Remote dictation never chooses the paired computer for meeting speech'); docs/port/differences.md a25-remote-meeting-consent

differences.openwhisper: A saved meeting_speaker_id_backend of openai is used until OpenAI retires the model on 2027-02-26 and reads as local from that day.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: A saved openai reads as local from the start; the optional OpenAI speaker pass runs only from the Past Meetings action, with a fresh confirmation for one saved meeting.
differences.reason: End-of-meeting processing, dashboard retries and stored grants must not start an upload of meeting audio on their own.
differences.source: docs/port/packages/M7.md 'Changes to the cut' item 4 (lead decision 4) and docs/port/open-items.md ('The optional OpenAI speaker pass runs from the desktop Past Meetings action'); src/models/meeting_speech.cpp resolve_meeting_speaker_id_backend, tests/models/test_meeting_speech.cpp

differences.openwhisper: A backup is an .owbackup ZIP with format id openwhisper-backup whose core members are data/openwhisper_settings.json and data/openwhisper.db; scheduled ones are named OpenWhisper-auto-*.owbackup.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: A backup is an .fvbackup ZIP with format id openwhisper-cpp-backup and members named from identity() (data/openwhisper_cpp_settings.json, data/openwhisper-cpp.db), with OpenWhisper's layout, limits and validation rules otherwise. OpenWhisper_CPP inspects and restores both kinds; OpenWhisper cannot read an .fvbackup.
differences.reason: OpenWhisper_CPP is a separate product with its own data root and file names; OpenWhisper's names are read only to import its data or restore its backups.
differences.source: docs/port/ARCHITECTURE.md, the identity names (AppIdentity: settings_file, restore_dir, backup_extension) and the backup format paragraph ('.fvbackup has OpenWhisper's layout and validation rules')

differences.openwhisper: OpenWhisper imports no other installation. Its own start runs on default settings when its settings JSON cannot be read and skips the legacy history migration when transcription_history.json cannot be merged; its backup create refuses both.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: Importing an OpenWhisper installation whose settings JSON cannot be read brings the default settings with the warning "OpenWhisper's settings could not be read; the default settings were imported", and a legacy transcription_history.json that cannot be merged is left out with the warning 'Could not merge transcription_history.json: <reason>'. A folder in place of the settings file still refuses the import. The warnings are logged.
differences.reason: The import brings what OpenWhisper's own next start would run on, rather than refusing data the user can still use.
differences.source: The import sweep of 2026-11-19 (open item backup/import.cpp (M3.7)); src/backup/import.cpp; tests/backup/test_sweep_import.cpp ('settings OpenWhisper cannot read import as its defaults', "a folder in place of OpenWhisper's settings still refuses the import", 'a legacy history OpenWhisper cannot read is left out of the import')
